headers.comment: The entry point must never be cached. Everything else is reached through it, so if a phone serves a stale index.html the whole app is stale -- which is exactly what happened after the art and mission-briefing deploys.
Code and styles change most sessions, and there is no build step adding content hashes to filenames, so these have to revalidate too. They are small; the round trip costs little.
Character art and fonts are the heavy bytes and effectively never change once named. Cache them hard so a phone on venue wifi only pays for them once.
